rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for distinctness in understanding, speech, images, light, or colour, but not usually for clear water.

example.english: The clearness of this photo is really impressive.
example.traditional: 呢張相嘅清晰度真係好高。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 cing1 sik1 dou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the transparency or clearness of water and other liquids.

example.english: The clearness of this water is so high that you can drink it straight.
example.traditional: 呢杯水嘅清澈度好高，可以直接飲。
example.jyutping: nei1 bui1 seoi2 ge3 cing1 cit3 dou6 hou2 gou1 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 jam2

rows.note: Use this for how unobstructed a path, route, or system is.

example.english: The clearness of the route is pretty good today; there were no traffic jams on the way to work.
example.traditional: 今日條路嘅暢通情況唔錯，返工冇塞車。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tiu4 lou6 ge3 coeng3 tung1 cing4 fong3 m4 co3 faan1 gung1 mou5 sak1 ce1
